questions.question: The value of X<sub>d</sub>'' for 2 pole Turbo alternator in the range of:

explanations.a: Correct. Subtransient reactance (Xd'') for 2-pole turbo alternators is typically 0.07 to 0.12 pu.
explanations.b: Incorrect. That range is too high.
explanations.c: Incorrect. That is for synchronous reactance.
explanations.d: Incorrect. That range is for salient pole machines.

questions.question: The value of X<sub>d</sub>'' for water wheel alternators in the range of:

explanations.a: Correct. For water wheel (salient pole) alternators, subtransient reactance is typically 0.1 to 0.35 pu.
explanations.b: Incorrect. That is synchronous reactance range.
explanations.c: Incorrect. That is for turbo alternators.

questions.question: Which statement is correct just after fault:

explanations.a: Incorrect. All three are not equal.
explanations.b: Correct. Subtransient reactance is smallest, transient reactance is larger, synchronous reactance is largest. Xd'' < Xd' < Xd.

questions.question: The reactances of a synchronous machine depend upon:

answers.c: Degree of saturation of magnetic core

explanations.a: Incorrect. Applied voltage is not a direct factor.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Leakage flux is a component but not the complete answer.
explanations.c: Correct. Reactances are affected by saturation of the magnetic core, which changes with operating conditions.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Power factor does not determine reactance values.

questions.question: Line to line fault in a transmission line is a:

explanations.b: Correct. Line-to-line fault (L-L) is an unsymmetrical fault because the three phases are not equally affected.
